mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_question_bank WHERE question_type = #{questionType} AND is_enable = 1
SELECT * FROM ai_question_bank WHERE question_type = #{questionType} AND subject = #{subject} AND is_enable = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_question_bank (question_type, question_content, core_point, answer, difficulty_level, subject, score, ai_tag, is_enable, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{questionType}, #{questionContent}, #{corePoint}, #{answer}, #{difficultyLevel}, #{subject}, #{score}, #{aiTag}, #{isEnable}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_question_bank SET question_type = #{questionType}, question_content = #{questionContent}, core_point = #{corePoint}, answer = #{answer}, difficulty_level = #{difficultyLevel}, subject = #{subject}, score = #{score}, ai_tag = #{aiTag}, is_enable = #{isEnable}, update_time = NOW() WHERE question_id = #{questionId}
